title: Telepathic projection from a Canadian facility to make Michigan residents mail their tax forms
place_text: south central Canada; Upper Peninsula of Michigan; West Virginia

tellings.quote: and 85% of the people did it next year.

plain: In the 1970s, people at a facility in south central Canada supposedly used telepathy to push residents of Michigan's Upper Peninsula into mailing their tax forms, and "85% of the people did it next year." The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this comes from reports the psychic Ingo Swann made to the Guardian's Office, an internal department of the Church of Scientology, and his account also involves the psychic Pat Price and West Virginia. If true, it would mean mind influence at a distance had been tested on ordinary citizens.
